question.text: Two mercury drops (each of radius $\mathrm{r}$ ) merge to form a bigger drop. The surface energy of the bigger drop, if $\mathrm{T}$ is the surface tension, is

solution.text:
$\frac{4}{3} \pi R^{3}=2 \times \frac{4}{3} \pi r^{3} \Rightarrow \mathrm{R}=2^{1 / 3} \mathrm{r}$
Surface energy of bigger drop,
$\mathrm{E}=4 \pi R^{2} T=4 \times 2^{2 / 3} \pi r^{2} T=2^{8 / 3} \pi r^{2} T$
